rule: single-pick question guesser, 5 draws, gold picked <= 2; target >= 80% of items

question_marks.rule: marks: ec-v5c over the draws, one statement per mark (marks_verdict)

described_marks.rule: marks: ec-v5c over the draws, one statement per mark (marks_verdict)

blind_marks.rule: marks: ec-v5c over the draws, one statement per mark (marks_verdict)

floors_note: measured with fresh draws (wsbench baseline kind=lucky_guessing, WSB_BANK_FILE_MORAL_RATIONALE=evals/moral_rationale/items_v4.json); instrument field = the registered stamp at measurement (ec-v5d); bank v4 is judged under ec-v6 (same prompts and scoring)

adversarial.note: round 0 = bank v3 lists as they are; the gate re-draws fresh each round; a round that changed no list of an item is a re-roll (reroll: true), recorded and never kept (settle)
